jobs.title: Associate Director S&OP Excellence and Planning Analytics
jobs.description:
Earlier this year, Unilever announced an agreement to combine its Foods business with McCormick & Company, creating a scaled global flavour powerhouse. The proposed combination would bring together iconic Foods brands, including Hellmann’s and Knorr, with McCormick’s portfolio to create a global leader across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by strong retail and foodservice platforms. McCormick brings more than 135 years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, with completion estimated for mid-2027.

Job Purpose

This role exists to strengthen how the North America Foods business plans, decides, and delivers across demand, supply, inventory, service, cost, and business waste. As Associate Director, S&OP Excellence and Planning Analytics, you will lead the planning excellence and analytics agenda that connects business ambition with practical, reliable operating plans. You will help build a more resilient, data-driven, and collaborative supply chain that enables trusted Foods brands to serve customers and consumers with confidence. This is inclusive of planning technology, analytics, and process.

You will be part of a team that believes planning is more than a process. It is a critical way of bringing people together, making better decisions, and creating the conditions for sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead the development and continuous improvement of integrated planning and sales and operations planning practices across North America Foods (Retail and Foods Solutions; US and Canada). You will partner closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Material Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Customer Development, Marketing, and senior Supply Chain leaders to ensure the business has clear plans, strong governance, reporting/tools, and actionable insights to support growth, service, efficiency, and transformation.

Lead a team of WL1s/2s to drive the sales and operations planning excellence agenda. Ensure robust process and technology are in place to ensure demand, supply, inventory, service, cost, and financial assumptions are connected through clear business rhythms and decision-making forums.
Partner with integrated planning teams to identify risks, opportunities, and gaps within planning technology/process and drive improvement plans. Identify / build business cases or drive cross functional process improvement.
Strengthen integrated planning capability by improving processes, tools, routines, governance, and ways of working across the North America Foods planning community.
Lead planning performance management, including the maintenance and creation and use of clear measures, scorecards, dashboards, reports, and insights that help teams make faster and better decisions. This can include modifying existing dashboards due to new business insights
Drive continuous improvement, simplification, and standardization across planning processes to improve reliability, reduce complexity, and support scalable ways of working.
Act as the primary point of contact for Planning TSAs.
Support the transition to the future Foods organization by helping design, build, and embed planning capabilities that enable business continuity from day one and maturity over time.
Build trusted relationships across functions and levels, creating a collaborative planning culture where teams are aligned, accountable, and focused on shared outcomes.

What The First Year Looks Like

During the first year, you will play a visible role in building planning excellence for the future North America Foods organization. You will learn the current planning landscape, connect with key partners across the business, and help establish the routines, measures, and decision-making forums needed to support business continuity and performance.

In your first few months, you will focus on understanding the end-to-end planning processes, key business priorities, current pain points, and transition requirements. You will build relationships with the planning community, data/tech teams, and cross-functional partners, assess existing tools and processes, and identify where stronger governance or simplification is needed.

As the year progresses, you will lead improvements to planning routines, performance reporting, and sales and operations planning governance. You will help teams align on clear roles, timelines, inputs, decisions, and escalation paths, while supporting capability-building across the planning organization.

By the end of the first year, you will have helped create a stronger integrated planning foundation for North America Foods, with clearer decision-making, improved planning visibility, stronger cross-functional alignment, and practical tools that support service, inventory, cost, waste reduction, and growth.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Significant experience 10y+ in integrated planning, demand planning, supply planning, business planning, supply chain transformation, or related end-to-end supply chain roles.
Strong understanding of sales and operations planning, forecasting, inventory management, capacity planning, supply planning, service management, and business waste reduction.
Experience leading cross-functional planning decisions and balancing service, inventory, cost, responsiveness, and growth priorities.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear business recommendations.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading change in a complex, fast-moving environment.
Demonstrated ability to build capability, improve processes, and create practical ways of working that teams can adopt and sustain.
Strong understanding of planning tools and technology including back end master data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in consumer goods, food and beverage, manufacturing, retail, or another complex supply chain environment.
Experience leading sales and operations planning improvements, integrated planning transformation, or planning excellence programs across multiple teams or markets.
Experience with advanced planning systems, enterprise resource planning systems, business intelligence tools, or planning analytics platforms.
Experience supporting organization transition, business separation, integration, or large-scale transformation activities.
Advanced degree or professional certification in supply chain, operations, planning, project management, or continuous improvement.

Director, Technical Solutions (Enterprise Application Integrations)
jobs.description:
Permanent Full Time

We are looking for a Director, Technical Solutions – Enterprise Application Integrations

The Director, Technical Solutions – Enterprise Application Integrations will lead teams responsible for designing and delivering the integration capabilities that connect our applications, data and digital experiences.

This is a leadership role spanning delivery, technology, engineering, and people. The Director will help shape our enterprise integration strategy and engineering practices, enabling teams across Canada Life to build and consume secure, resilient and reusable business capabilities.

What You Will Do

Lead engineering teams responsible for the design, development, delivery and support of enterprise integration solutions, including APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations and other integration patterns.
Build strong relationships with business and technology partners, understanding their priorities and delivering integration solutions that enable their initiatives and business outcomes.
Help shape and execute the technical strategy and roadmap for Enterprise Application Integration, aligned with enterprise architecture and business priorities.
Drive the modernisation of integration solutions, increasing the use of API-led, event-driven and cloud-native approaches while reducing legacy complexity and technical debt.
Establish and champion engineering standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures that improve consistency, security, resilience and speed of delivery.
Provide technical leadership on complex initiatives, guiding architecture and engineering decisions across integration, APIs, microservices and distributed systems.
Strengthen engineering excellence and operational resilience through DevSecOps, automation, testing, observability and strong production practices.
Partner across Architecture, Integration Platforms, Cloud, Cyber Security, Data and application teams to deliver secure, scalable and reliable solutions.
Build and develop high-performing engineering teams, growing technical capability, developing leaders and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What You Will Bring

Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven technology and engineering leadership experience, including leading and developing high-performing teams.
Strong delivery leadership, with the ability to translate business priorities into technology outcomes and drive complex initiatives through to delivery.
Strong knowledge of enterprise integration and distributed systems, including APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture and modern integration patterns.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with business and technology partners, influence across organisational boundaries and solve complex business problems through technology.
Strong technical and architectural judgement, with the ability to balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery decisions.
Experience coaching and developing technical leaders and practitioners, creating an environment of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to make complex technology topics understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A bias for action, curiosity and critical thinking, with the ability to adapt quickly as business and technology priorities evolve.
A growth mindset and willingness to challenge existing approaches, experiment and continuously improve how teams work and deliver.
Experience working in the financial services, insurance or wealth management industry.
Hands-on experience earlier in your career in software development, solution architecture, systems analysis or another technical engineering discipline.
Experience with cloud technologies and modern cloud architectures.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and global delivery models.
Experience with product-oriented technology delivery or product management practices.
Experience driving DevSecOps, automation, observability, reliability and operational excellence within engineering organisations.
Experience using engineering, delivery and operational metrics to understand performance, identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Knowledge of insurance and wealth business domains and the technology ecosystems that support them.
Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life.

The base salary for this position is between $121,200.00 - $171,200.00
annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a long-established, privately held organization operating a multi-site, customer-focused business across retail, wholesale, distribution, logistics and related services. The company has grown significantly and built a strong reputation through operational excellence, long-term relationships and a commitment to continuous improvement. Its culture is highly collaborative, performance-oriented and grounded in servant leadership, with leaders expected to be accountable, approachable and engaged while fostering an environment focused on teamwork, accountability and results.

Reporting to the President and Chief Executive Officer, the Vice President, Finance leads the organization’s Finance and People & Culture functions and serves as a key member of the senior leadership team. This is a highly operational leadership role for a finance executive who takes an active interest in how the business runs and enjoys working directly with leaders and teams across the organization. Leading accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, data analysis, credit, cash flow, working capital and financial controls, the Vice President will provide timely and meaningful insight into performance. The role’s financial responsibilities also extend to a related property business that owns most of the organization’s operating locations, together with a small portfolio of other commercial properties.

Working closely with ownership and business leaders, the Vice President will strengthen visibility into sales, margins, expenses, inventory and profitability; enhance planning, reporting and decision support; and help drive greater consistency across financial processes, systems and controls. By engaging directly with the business and developing a firsthand understanding of operational challenges, the Vice President will help translate financial and operational insight into practical improvements in performance.

A key priority will be supporting the continued adoption and optimization of a recently implemented enterprise system, improving the quality and accessibility of financial and operational data, and helping business leaders leverage analytics to make better decisions. The successful candidate will also bring an active interest in artificial intelligence and a commitment to ongoing learning, working with leaders across the organization to identify practical applications that improve productivity, decision-making and business performance.

In addition to leading Finance, the Vice President will provide executive oversight to the People & Culture function. Working closely with the Senior Director, People & Culture, this leader will help ensure the organization’s talent, leadership and organizational capabilities support its strategic and operational priorities. The Vice President will strengthen a capable, service-oriented team across both functions while building the processes and discipline necessary to support future growth.

The ideal candidate is a finance leader with demonstrated success leading accounting and finance functions in a complex, customer-focused business. Experience in retail, wholesale distribution or another operationally complex, inventory-intensive environment would be highly relevant. Collaborative, humble, credible and highly hands-on, this servant leader will be equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves to work through complex issues as they are coaching and developing others. They will bring strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity and a practical problem-solving approach, with the ability to identify root causes, navigate ambiguity and translate analysis into action. Experience with ERP system optimization and enhanced reporting through data analytics will be highly valued.

Based in Metro Vancouver, this is an exceptional opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a respected privately held organization. Working closely with ownership, senior leadership and teams across the business, the successful candidate will build on a solid foundation and help position the company for continued success.

To explore this opportunity further, please submit your resume by clicking ‘apply’.

We thank all applicants for their interest in this position. Please note that we will only be in contact with those individuals moving forward with our client.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.

About Us

At Baycrest Hospital, older adults receive specialized post-acute inpatient care informed by deep expertise in aging and brain health, delivered with compassion and clinical excellence.

The Finance Department provides financial planning, accounting, financial reporting, budgeting support, regulatory reporting, treasury, and financial management services in support of Baycrest Hospital operations. The department ensures the integrity of financial information, compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements, effective stewardship of financial resources, and timely decision support for leaders across the organization.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Vice President, Finance and CFO, the Director, Financial Accounting and Systems Integration works as a partner with the Director, Finance and provides leadership for Baycrest Hospital's financial accounting, reporting, compliance, and financial systems functions.

The Director is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial information through the effective management of accounting operations, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, capital accounting, internal controls, regulatory reporting, audit coordination, and compliance activities.

The Director serves as the Finance lead for major technology, systems, and business transformation initiatives impacting financial operations, reporting, controls, data management, and decision support capabilities. Working collaboratively with Information Technology, Human Resources, Payroll, Decision Support, operational leaders, project teams, and external partners, the Director ensures Finance requirements are appropriately incorporated into the planning, design, implementation, integration, testing, and optimization of enterprise systems and related business processes.

The Director works collaboratively with Payroll and Human Resources to support the integrity, governance, integration, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis of workforce-related financial and operational data.

The Director is responsible for the management of assigned staff and works collaboratively with Finance leadership and organizational stakeholders to support operational excellence, continuous improvement, regulatory compliance, and informed decision-making across Baycrest Hospital.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting, Reporting and Compliance

Provides strategic and operational leadership for Baycrest Hospital's financial accounting, reporting, and financial operations functions.
Oversees the integrity, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial information and reporting.
Directs and oversees monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, including account reconciliations, accruals, journal entries, and financial statement preparation.
Oversees the management and reconciliation of the General Ledger and related accounting records.
Ensures financial transactions are recorded and reported in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Public Sector Accounting Standards (PSAS), organizational policies, and applicable legislation.
Leads the preparation and review of internal financial statements and supports financial planning processes.
Oversees Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, banking, cash management, and assigned financial operations.
Oversees capital accounting, capital project reporting, asset management, deferred contributions, and related funding requirements.
Provides expert advice and guidance to leaders across the organization regarding accounting standards, financial reporting, internal controls, financial policies, and financial risk management.
Supports organizational planning, resource allocation, and operational decision-making through the provision of financial expertise and analysis.

MIS Submissions

Collaborates with Human Resources, Payroll, Decision Support, Information Technology, and operational leaders to ensure the integrity, consistency, and accuracy of data supporting MIS and related reporting submissions.
Monitors data quality, reporting integrity, and compliance with reporting standards and recommends corrective actions as required.

Internal Controls, Audit and Risk Management

Develops, implements, and maintains financial controls, policies, procedures, and monitoring processes to safeguard organizational assets and ensure financial accountability.
Leads annual external audit activities and serves as the primary liaison with auditors for assigned hospital operations and reporting areas.
Coordinates audit requests and ensures timely completion of audit schedules, supporting documentation, analyses, recommendations, and action plans.
Identifies financial, operational, reporting, compliance, and system-related risks and develops mitigation strategies where appropriate.
Supports organizational risk management initiatives through strong financial oversight, governance, and accountability practices.
Recommends and implements improvements to strengthen financial controls, reporting accuracy, operational effectiveness, and regulatory compliance.

Systems Integration and Business Transformation

Ensures financial, accounting, reporting, compliance, control, and data governance requirements are incorporated into enterprise systems and related business processes.

Identifies opportunities to improve business processes through automation, standardization, workflow redesign, and enhanced system functionality.

Promotes effective governance, stewardship, integrity, and security of financial and operational data across systems.

Oversees workload distribution, performance management, and staff development activities.

Identifies opportunities to improve financial processes, compliance activities, reporting capabilities, systems functionality, internal controls, and operational effectiveness.
